_comment: Hero ability descriptions for hero-conditioned card metadata. Add heroes as needed for training. Class/talent are auto-detected from card data; only 'ability' and optionally 'intellect'/'life' need manual entry.

ira_crimson_haze.ability: Once per Turn Action - 0: Attack with Ira. (When you attack with a weapon, your attack action cards gain go again this turn. Ira has 0 power.)

ira_scarlet_revenger.ability: Once per Turn Action - 0: Attack with Ira. If Ira has hit this turn, she gains +2 power for this attack. (When you attack with a weapon, your attack action cards gain go again this turn.)

katsu.ability: Once per Turn Instant - 0: If a Combo card you control hits, search your deck for a card with Combo, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck.

benji_the_piercing_wind.ability: When you play your second action card each turn, draw a card.

bravo.ability: Guardian hero. When you defend with a card from hand that has defense 3 or greater, you may draw a card at the end of the chain link.

dorinthea.ability: Once per Turn Effect - When your weapon attack hits a hero, your next weapon attack this turn gains +1 power.

rhinar.ability: Once per Turn Action - 0: Discard a random card. If a card with 6 or more power is discarded this way, draw a card, then your attacks gain intimidate this turn.

dash.ability: Once per Turn Instant - 0: If you have boosted this turn, you may banish a Mechanologist item from your hand with cost 2 or less. If you do, put it into the arena.

viserai.ability: Whenever you play a Runeblade non-attack action card, create a Runechant token.

vynnset.ability: Once per Turn Action - Destroy any number of Runechant tokens you control: Deal that much arcane damage to target hero, then you lose that much life.

chane.ability: Once per Turn Instant - 0: You may play a card with blood debt from your banished zone. At the beginning of your end phase, you lose 1 life for each card with blood debt in your banished zone.

kano.ability: Instant - 0: Look at the top card of your deck. You may play it as though it were an instant. If it has Wizard in its name, it gains +1 arcane damage.

dromai.ability: Once per Turn Action - 0: Create an Ash token. Go again.

fai.ability: Whenever a Draconic chain link resolves, deal 1 arcane damage to each opposing hero.

lexi.ability: Once per Turn Instant - 0: You may put an arrow from your arsenal face up into the bow zone. If you do, your next arrow attack this turn gains dominate.

prism.ability: Once per Turn Instant - 0: Create a Spectral Shield token. (If your hero would be dealt damage, you may instead destroy a Spectral Shield you control.)

azalea.ability: Once per Turn Action - 0: Put an arrow from your hand face up into the bow zone. If you do, it gains dominate.

kassai.ability: When you attack with a weapon, if this is the second or later weapon attack this turn, create a Copper token. (Copper is an item with 'Action - Destroy this: Gain 1 resource.')

oldhim.ability: Essence of Earth and Ice - At the start of your turn, you may pitch an Earth or Ice card from your hand. If you pitch an Earth card, gain 1 life. If you pitch an Ice card, the next attack action card you play this turn gains +1 power.
